newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end steady, downside fragile.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end steady, downside fragile.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures received a slight boost late on Tuesday following a decline on the Japanese bond market, but dealers said the market remained vulnerable on the downside.
After hitting a low of 20,490, the benchmark Nikkei 225 December contract ended 10 points above its previous settlement of 20,710.
"I'd expect it to go back down below 20,510 to 20,410 and if that gives way, we could go all the way to 20,100," said a trader with a European futures house.
"The sheer weight of money flowing into the fixed interest market will just weigh on equities," he added.

Dealers said news that Japan's July-September gross domestic product rose a real 0.1 percent from the previous quarter was unlikely to have a major impact on the market as it was broadly in line with expectations.
